name: Animalica Core
description: the fox has paws in the settings. Animalica Core keeps the shared traits, diets, presets and model handling together; the animal bodies live in their own packs. fish get their underwater breathing, collision caps stay optional, and grazers can build a firepit or pit kiln with dry grass without eating the construction supplies. Carried compatibility checks the loaded rig, including compatible Bixo bodies. a compatible rig is still required.
